description: Dragonfly -- VNA Forklift AGV, high-bay VNA pallet racking, WMS Reflex integration
known_issues: requirements block predates direct PDF verification; the real document states 'Max Loaded weight (KG) (Footprint) 1000' (not max_payload_kg=1500) — see golden_extraction for the hand-verified value, left here unchanged rather than silently rewritten

required_min_aisle_width_m intentionally omitted from golden_extraction: the real document text is 'Aisle width is 2000 mm rack-to-rack, with a minimum of 1900 mm pallet-to-pallet' (not min_aisle_width_mm=1800 from the requirements block either). field_levels.json defines this field as KO_IF_GT, which by the documented conservative-minimum convention (see git history of test_extraction_nulls.py) should extract the narrowest value, 1.9 m -- but the captured pipeline run currently extracts the nominal value, 2.0 m. Both numbers are grounded in the same sentence, so source_is_grounded() cannot distinguish them; this is an extraction-direction question, not a hallucination, and is left unasserted here pending a decision rather than silently picking a side.
notes: VNA APR racking ~54,000 positions, WMS=Reflex, ISO 3691-4 required, 22h/day 364d/year. CA certification needed.
